paragraphs: The GLK350 uses the M272 — a 3.0-litre V6 petrol engine that was fitted throughout the X204 generation from 2008 to 2015. This engine was widely used across the Mercedes range of that era and is known for its smooth power delivery. The GLK-Class was discontinued in 2015 and succeeded by the GLC, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every GLK350 on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the GLK350 from 2023 to present. The M256 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older M276 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every M256 rebuild.
